evals.expected_output: A read-only audit, a request to add the report card, then a report card to the right of the frame with IDs, coverage, and saved findings, plus a short chat summary.
expectations: Every search_design_system call passes includeLibraryKeys with only the Alloy library key
Makes no Figma writes before asking to add the report card
